inspiration: Edge-placed hub, generated field: the town is placed on one edge of the map and the wilderness is generated outward from the opposite side; in the south-edge case, water-border stamps are placed along one side of the map (d2core/d2map/d2mapgen/act1_overworld.go:53-79). Recreate as a hub on one edge of a fight zone with the field spreading from it.

Stamp as a preset piece: a preset map piece is loaded and placed like a stamp by position (d2core/d2map/d2mapstamp/stamp.go:20; factory.go:31-32). Recreate as a prefab room in our zone data with a placement position and a size.

Free-space check before placing: an area counts as empty only inside the map bounds and only when no tile on it has a floor (d2core/d2map/d2mapgen/map_generator.go:47-57; the lines read check floors only). Recreate as a placement rule for spawn points and props so nothing spawns in the wrong place.

Layered equipment on a directional animation: a direction is a set of cells that are recalculated per frame (d2dcc/dcc_direction_frame.go:57-70), and 64 facings map onto the stored directions (d2dcc/dcc_dir_lookup.go:13, function name only, not read). Recreate as a body with gear layers composed per frame, so armour swaps without new art. Maps to parity row 15 (gear dressing).

Stat formulas as tiny expressions: item stat rules are parsed from text with unary and ternary operators (d2common/d2calculation/d2parser/operations.go:48 getTernaryOperations; lexer in d2lexer/lexer.go). Recreate as a data field per item that holds a small formula, so new items need no new code. Keep the operators small.

briefs.label: Edge-hub field
briefs.why: A hub on one side of the screen with a field growing away from it. At 375 wide the hub reads as the safe edge, the field as the risk.
briefs.keep: Hub placed on an edge. Field generated outward from it. A border strip on one side.
briefs.change: Our hub is a cliff ledge or a sky island rather than a town, the field spirals outward, the border is fog rather than water. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Gear-layer hero
briefs.why: Armour that is drawn as layers over one body means every gear piece is a layer, not a new sprite sheet.
briefs.keep: Body and gear as separate layers composed per frame. Facing lookup from a 64-direction table.
briefs.change: Our layers are a fixed stack per silhouette slot (helm, shoulder, plate, cape), tuned for the 375 px fight camera, with a palette per layer. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Formula item
briefs.why: An item that carries its own small rule keeps the item table honest: one formula per item, no code per item.
briefs.keep: A small expression language with ternary and unary operators, parsed from text.
briefs.change: Our formulas are limited to the stat names in our catalogue, and the inspect screen shows the result as a plain line, not the formula. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
